name: Carla
source:
A queen of knights who is greedy and arrogant, and she gets what she wants even if it means stealing it.
Although she is greedy, she is worshiped by her people because she enriches her country by invading other countries.
She invaded and stole Erika's homeland.

Translated from https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1264144
